errors.CONTEXT_MISSING: This change was refused because no signed-in user was recorded for it.
errors.DELETE_FORBIDDEN: Records cannot be deleted. Cancel or deactivate them instead.
errors.ROW_IMMUTABLE: This record is final and can no longer be changed.
errors.AUDIT_PROTECTED: The audit log can never be changed or deleted.
errors.NUMBERING_TAMPER: Document numbers can only advance one at a time.
errors.DRAFT_REQUIRED: Lines can only be changed while the document is a draft.
errors.SERIES_NOT_FOUND: The numbering series was not found or is not active.
errors.OWNER_PROTECTED: The owner account is protected: there is only one owner, who cannot be deactivated or lose any permission.
errors.APPROVAL_INVALID: This approval is not valid. It may have expired, been used already, been given by someone without the permission, or been given for a different change.
errors.SIGN_IN_NOT_ALLOWED: This sign-in is not allowed on this PC or for this user.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_ENROLLED: This PC is not enrolled. Ask the owner for an enrollment code.
errors.DEVICE_REVOKED: This PC was revoked and can no longer connect to the server.
errors.DEVICE_KEY_EXPIRED: This PC's key has expired. Enroll it again with a new code from the owner.
errors.CLIENT_OUTDATED: This version of the app is too old (minimum {minVersion}). Update it to continue.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.SESSION_LOCKED: The screen is locked. Enter your password or PIN to continue.
errors.SECOND_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.CREDENTIAL_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Choose your own new password or PIN to continue.
errors.TWO_STEP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up the 2-step code on your phone to continue.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request was already sent with different details. Nothing was changed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Account locked for {minutes} minutes after too many failed attempts. The owner can unlock it in Settings.
errors.PIN_BLOCKED: This PIN is blocked after too many wrong tries. Ask the owner to unblock it in Settings.
errors.INVALID_TWO_STEP_CODE: That code is wrong or expired. Enter the new code from the app.
errors.RECOVERY_REFUSED: The username, the 6-digit code or the recovery code is wrong. Check them and try again.
errors.PASSWORD_REJECTED: This password cannot be used. Choose a longer or less common one.
errors.PIN_REJECTED: This PIN cannot be used. Choose 4 digits that are not easy to guess.
errors.ENROLLMENT_FAILED: The enrollment code is wrong or has expired. Ask the owner for a new code.
errors.ENROLLMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Enrollment is not available yet: the server's secure connection is not set up.
errors.DEVICE_PROTECTED: This PC cannot be revoked here: it is the server or the PC you are using now.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some information is missing or not valid.
errors.DUPLICATE: A record with the same details already exists.
errors.REFERENCE_MISSING: A linked record does not exist.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.BUSY_RETRY: The system is busy with the same records. Please try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The operation took too long and was cancelled. Nothing was saved.
errors.MONEY_FORMAT: The amount {value} is not a valid number.
errors.RULE_VIOLATION: This change breaks a rule and was not saved.
errors.STALE_VERSION: Someone else changed this while you were editing it. Reload to see their changes, then make yours again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again or contact the administrator.

rules.REASON_REQUIRED: Write a reason: it is kept in the audit log.
rules.CODE_FIXED: A code never changes once the record is created.
rules.REFERENCE_INACTIVE: Something chosen here is deactivated. Choose an active one.
rules.STILL_USED: This is still used by active records. Change or deactivate those first.
rules.DEFAULT_REQUIRED: There must always be a default. Choose another one as the default instead.
rules.QUANTITY_DECIMALS: This quantity has more decimals than its unit allows.
rules.ACCOUNT_PARENT_NOT_HEADER: An account can only sit under a header account.
rules.ACCOUNT_PARENT_TYPE: A sub-account must have the same type as its header.
rules.ACCOUNT_PARENT_INACTIVE: The header account is deactivated. Reactivate it first.
rules.ACCOUNT_LOOP: An account cannot sit under one of its own sub-accounts.
rules.ACCOUNT_HAS_CHILDREN: This account has sub-accounts. Move or deactivate them first.
rules.ACCOUNT_IN_USE: This account is in use, so its type, header choice, control flag and active state cannot change.
rules.MAPPING_ACCOUNT_INVALID: This event needs an active account of the right type that can receive postings.
rules.BUSINESS_LINE_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Choose an active revenue account and an active cost-of-sales account that can receive postings.
rules.PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_INVALID: A payment method needs an active asset account that can receive postings.
rules.REASON_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Choose an active account that can receive postings.
rules.PERIOD_STATUS_STEP: A month goes from open to closed to locked, one step at a time.
rules.PERIOD_GAP: Months are added one after another, with no gaps.
rules.PERIOD_LOCKED: This month is locked for good and can never be reopened.
rules.PERIOD_NOT_ENDED: A month can be closed only after it has ended.
rules.PERIOD_ORDER: Months are closed and locked in order, and reopened latest first.
rules.SERIES_IN_USE: Numbers were already issued from this series, so its prefix, width and start can no longer change.
rules.VAT_RATE_OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can change a VAT rate.
rules.ITEM_TYPE_FIXED: This item is already used, so its type can no longer change.
rules.ITEM_IN_ACTIVE_KIT: This item is part of an active kit. Remove it from the kit first.
rules.CATEGORY_LOOP: A category cannot sit under one of its own sub-categories.
rules.KIT_RULE: A kit is made of stock items and services only, never of another kit.
rules.PRICE_LEVEL_TYPE_TAKEN: This customer type already has its own price level.
rules.PRICE_REQUIRED: An item for sale needs a sale price above zero.
rules.WALK_IN_LOCKED: The walk-in customer "Cash customer" cannot be changed or deactivated.
rules.CREDIT_PERMISSION: Giving credit needs the "Give customers credit" permission.
rules.COST_PERMISSION: Changing a purchase price needs the "See and change purchase prices" permission (owner only).
rules.LOGO_INVALID: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG image of at most 512 KB.
rules.IMPORT_NOT_CHECKED: Check the file before importing it.
rules.IMPORT_FILE_CHANGED: The file changed after it was checked. Check it again.
rules.IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: The file has problems. Fix them in Excel, then check it again.
rules.PERIOD_NOT_OPEN: That month is closed or does not exist: nothing can be dated in it.
rules.STOCK_ITEM_ONLY: Services and kits have no stock.
rules.MOVEMENT_VALUE_REQUIRED: An incoming movement needs its value.
rules.ADJUSTMENT_REASON: This reason does not fit this kind of adjustment.
rules.ADJUSTMENT_LINE: The stock status does not fit this operation.
rules.COST_UNKNOWN: This item has no cost: type the unit cost or set the item's purchase price.
rules.OPENING_OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner posts opening stock.
rules.OPENING_ALREADY_POSTED: Opening stock is already posted for an item in this document. Any later change is a stock adjustment.
rules.PRINT_OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner designs print templates.
rules.ADVANCE_DEDUCTION: A deduction cannot be more than what remains of the payment, nor another customer's payment.
rules.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS: The amount is more than what remains on the document or of the payment.
rules.ALLOCATION_TARGET: A payment settles issued documents of its own customer only.
rules.COMPANY_MISSING: Fill in the company details first (Settings → Company).
rules.CREDIT_LIMIT: The unpaid amount is above the customer's credit. It must be paid, or a supervisor must approve.
rules.DISCOUNT_OVER_LIMIT: This discount is above your limit. A supervisor must approve it.
rules.DISCOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The discount is larger than the line amount.
rules.DOCUMENT_EMPTY: The document needs at least one line with an amount above zero.
rules.JOURNAL_MISSING: The journal entry is missing. Nothing was saved.
rules.LINE_KIND: This kind of line does not belong on this document.
rules.NOTE_EXCEEDS: A note cannot be more than the original quantity or amount.
rules.NOTE_LINE: A note line must refer to a line of the original document.
rules.NOTE_ORIGINAL: A note refers to an issued invoice of the same customer only.
rules.PAYMENT_METHOD: This payment method cannot be used here.
rules.PAYMENT_REVERSAL: A posted payment can be reversed only once, for its amount.
rules.PAYMENT_UNALLOCATED: The whole payment must be allocated.
rules.PRICE_OVERRIDE: Changing the price needs the permission or a supervisor's approval.
rules.STOCK_LINE: A stock line needs its stock movement.
rules.SERIES_MISMATCH: This numbering series does not fit this kind of document.
rules.SHIFT_NOT_OWNER: Only the shift's own cashier works on it.
rules.COUNT_TOTAL: A count's total must equal its lines.
rules.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: The value is above the limit: a supervisor's approval is needed.
rules.REVIEW_STEP: This was already reviewed or needs no review.
rules.DOCUMENT_STEP: This step is not possible in the document's current state.
rules.JOURNAL_UNBALANCED: The entry does not balance: debits do not equal credits.
rules.POSTING_ACCOUNT_INVALID: This account cannot receive postings (header or deactivated).
rules.POSTING_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: A line on a control account needs its customer.
